gwas_notes: Used PLINK --linear without mixed model correction. λ≈2.95 indicates severe genomic inflation. 716 'significant' SNPs are mostly false positives. NO Manhattan or QQ plots produced. LD clumping and lead SNP identification done. λ reported in summary.
regulatory_method: Ensembl gene overlap annotation (lncRNA/miRNA/snoRNA identification, gene function relevance)
regulatory_notes: No sequence extraction, no ML model, no pig-mutbert. Regulatory assessment via gene overlap and regulatory RNA identification from Ensembl. Categorical labels (HIGH/MODERATE) based on gene annotation, not sequence-based prediction. No numerical probability values from a model.
